phases.title: Shared infrastructure: state protocol, ledger extension, executor skeleton

commit.subject: setup executor infrastructure: state protocol, ledger extension, module skeleton

tasks.title: Define and implement executor state protocol schema
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/store.js exports versioned State class with schema validation, atomic write, readback, and recovery methods for runs, tasks, attempts, receipts, and intents
tasks.groupingRationale: State schema is foundational for all executor operations; its versioning, atomicity model, and recovery protocol must be defined as a single cohesive unit before dependent modules are implemented

commit.subject: add executor state protocol (store.js) with versioned schema and atomic writes

tasks.title: Implement backward-compatible ledger extension
tasks.outcome: lib/execution-ledger.js exports finalizeActivity function with status/tokens/reason/completedAt; preserves all existing open/close/fail/skip behavior; adds no duplicate counter
tasks.groupingRationale: Ledger extension maintains backward-compatible interface while adding executor-specific fields; single interface change requires unified testing and verification

commit.subject: add ledger finalizeActivity for executor task completion

tasks.title: Create task-executor module skeleton with public interface
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js exports execute, status, diagnose, stop, reconcile, resume, replan functions with documented signatures; module loads store, ownership, plan, claude-process, git, ledger modules

commands: node -e "const e = require('./lib/task-executor'); console.log(typeof e.execute, typeof e.resume)"

tasks.groupingRationale: Module skeleton establishes the single public API boundary; defining all seven command signatures and module dependencies is an atomic structural decision required before any US implementation begins

commit.subject: add task-executor module skeleton (index.js)

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to parse and validate the approved Work Breakdown, so that I can schedule tasks deterministically

commit.subject: implement US-01 approved-plan parsing and validation

tasks.title: Implement MD task detail parser
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/plan.js exports parseMarkdown function that extracts all 14 task fields from rendered Work Breakdown Markdown with lossless command fence preservation
tasks.groupingRationale: MD parsing is a single-concern parser module; it extracts lossless task details from a specific document format without validation logic, making it an atomic independently-testable unit

commit.subject: add Work Breakdown Markdown parser (plan.js)

tasks.title: Implement CSV parser and phase-task mapping
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/plan.js exports parseCSV and mapPhases functions; validates eight-column pipe-separated format, aggregates phase dependencies, reconciles task IDs with MD
tasks.groupingRationale: CSV parsing and phase-task mapping are closely coupled (CSV is the phase-level projection, MD is task detail); together they form a single cross-reference verification step that cannot be meaningfully split

commit.subject: add Work Breakdown CSV parser and phase mapping

tasks.title: Implement DAG validation and cycle detection
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/plan.js exports validateDAG function; rejects non-DAG graphs, duplicate task IDs, missing fields, and MD/CSV parity mismatches before any state mutation
tasks.groupingRationale: DAG validation and cycle detection are a single pre-dispatch check; both use the full graph state and must run atomically before execution can proceed

commit.subject: add DAG validation and cycle detection

tasks.title: Implement content digest and immutable plan snapshot
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/plan.js exports createPlanSnapshot; computes SHA256 over MD/CSV bytes and format version; binds digest to normalized task objects; snapshot is read-only for run lifetime
tasks.groupingRationale: Content digest and plan snapshot are atomic: the digest must bind to the normalized snapshot in a single operation to prevent detect-then-act races where plan changes between validation and binding

commit.subject: add plan snapshot with content digest

tasks.title: Implement stable topological scheduler (Kahn's algorithm)
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/plan.js exports computeReadyQueue; returns stable, deterministic task ordering by phase then source index then ID; two identical inputs produce identical schedules
tasks.groupingRationale: Stable topological scheduler is a single deterministic algorithm with specific tie-breaking rules (phase order, source index, ID); changing any rule requires changing the entire scheduler, making it an atomic implementation unit

commit.subject: add stable topological scheduler for task ordering

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to acquire an exclusive lock and prevent duplicate coordinators, so that I own the execution

commit.subject: implement US-02 exclusive lock and ownership protocol

tasks.title: Implement repo-wide execution lease protocol
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/ownership.js exports acquireLease, releaseLease, readLease; enforces one repo-wide coordinator; persists lease with nonce, host, PID, runId, generation
tasks.groupingRationale: Execution lease protocol is a cohesive ownership model with acquire/release/read operations; all three must share the same state schema and nonce/identity structures, making it an atomic unit

commit.subject: add exclusive lease protocol

tasks.title: Implement stale lock detection with process liveness checks
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/ownership.js exports checkOwnerLiveness; checks OS process identity and start time; permits recovery only with confirmed dead evidence; never by age alone
tasks.groupingRationale: Stale lock detection requires process identity and start-time verification as an atomic check; both signals are necessary and must be evaluated together before recovery is permitted

commit.subject: add stale lock detection with process liveness

tasks.title: Implement ownership guard for atomic lease transitions
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/ownership.js exports createOwnershipGuard; atomic compare-and-swap for lease acquisition/release/reclaim; exclusive mkdir guard prevents concurrent transitions
tasks.groupingRationale: Ownership guard implements a single atomic synchronization primitive (compare-and-swap with exclusive mkdir); the guard mechanism itself cannot be split without introducing race windows

commit.subject: add ownership guard for atomic lease transitions

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to dispatch one implementation agent per task per attempt, so that I can track execution precisely

commit.subject: implement US-03 single-task agent dispatch

tasks.title: Implement Claude subprocess adapter
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/claude-process.js exports spawnClaudeAgent; async spawn with shell:false, validated executable, stdin prompt feed, stdout/stderr buffering with result validation before verification
tasks.groupingRationale: Claude subprocess adapter is a single executable-spawning interface; all the details (shell:false, buffering, validation) are part of a coherent, independently-verifiable child-process abstraction

commit.subject: add Claude subprocess adapter with result validation

tasks.title: Implement agent provenance verification (FTR-017 contract)
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/claude-process.js exports verifyAgentIdentity; calls agents resolve --require-verified, caches nativeName/sha256/path, compares loaded definition with registry result
tasks.groupingRationale: Agent provenance verification is a single FTR-017 contract check; the resolve call, caching, and comparison form an atomic pre-dispatch guard that cannot be split without losing verification integrity

commit.subject: add agent provenance verification via agents resolve

tasks.title: Implement task dispatch orchestration with ownership coordination
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js dispatches single task per attempt; persists run/task/attempt identity and ledger activity before invocation; blocks dispatch on missing lock, failed pre-dispatch checks, or identity verification failure
tasks.groupingRationale: Task dispatch orchestration coordinates lock validation, pre-dispatch checks, persistence, and subprocess invocation; these are all prerequisites for a single observable outcome (one task dispatched exactly once) and must be atomic

commit.subject: add task dispatch orchestration

tasks.title: Implement result capture and immediate telemetry persistence
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/store.js persists implementation result receipt before verification; records tokens (or null with reason), elapsed/active time, exit code, outcome; does not overwrite existing attempts
tasks.groupingRationale: Result receipt persistence is a single durable record; all fields (tokens, time, exit code, outcome) must be written atomically before verification runs, enforcing the BR-06 precondition

commit.subject: add result receipt persistence

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to run verifications and review, so that I can validate task outcomes before commit

commit.subject: implement US-04 verifications and review

tasks.title: Implement verification command executor
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js runVerifications executes approved fenced command blocks from Work Breakdown; requires each command exit 0; persists each result before proceeding to review
tasks.groupingRationale: Verification command executor is a single execution engine for approved fenced blocks; command extraction, execution, exit-code validation, and result persistence form a cohesive pre-review pipeline

commit.subject: add verification command executor

tasks.title: Implement review agent dispatch with diff context
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js runReview dispatches review-solution agent with task context, exact diff, and review criteria; reads review result and validation rules
tasks.groupingRationale: Review agent dispatch is a single orchestration step that packages task context, diff, and criteria for the review-solution agent; context assembly and dispatch are inseparable

commit.subject: add review agent dispatch

tasks.title: Implement verification and review outcome persistence
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/store.js persists verification exit codes and review receipt with passed/failed status and blocking findings before proceeding to checkpoint
tasks.groupingRationale: Verification and review outcome persistence is a single durable record that enforces BR-09 (verification before review before checkpoint); all outcomes must be persisted atomically

commit.subject: add verification and review outcome persistence

tasks.title: Write verification and review integration tests
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/verification-review.test.js covers full verification+review+outcome cycle with multiple command blocks, review pass/fail scenarios, and outcome persistence validation
tasks.groupingRationale: Integration test for the full verification+review cycle requires testing with fake agents, command blocks, and persistence together; the cycle is indivisible and requires a single test suite to verify end-to-end behavior

commit.subject: add verification and review integration tests

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to checkpoint, stage, commit, and register SHA, so that I can persist verified work to the repository

commit.subject: implement US-05 checkpoint and commit protocol

tasks.title: Implement checkpoint intent persistence
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/git.js exports persistCheckpointIntent; records feature/run/task/attempt/baseline SHA/expected tree/review/diff inventory/commit message before any commit attempt
tasks.groupingRationale: Checkpoint intent is a single pre-commit record capturing all required metadata (baseline SHA, expected tree, inventory); this must be persisted atomically before any staging occurs to enable safe recovery

commit.subject: add checkpoint intent persistence

tasks.title: Implement controlled staging with path enumeration
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/git.js exports stageTaskFiles; stages only task-attributable paths via argv, validates resulting tree equals intent, detects hook mutations or external changes
tasks.groupingRationale: Controlled staging with path enumeration, validation, and mutation detection is a single atomic step; all three checks (path match, tree validation, hook detection) must run together before commit is attempted

commit.subject: add controlled staging with path enumeration

tasks.title: Implement commit creation with task trailers
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/git.js exports createTaskCommit; commits with AI-Toolkit-Run/Task/Attempt/Plan trailers; validates parent/tree/ancestry on correct branch; detects hook failures
tasks.groupingRationale: Commit creation with trailers is a single atomic operation; all validations (parent, tree, ancestry, branch, hooks) must complete before the commit is recorded, enforcing BR-15 (no external modifications)

commit.subject: add commit creation with task trailers

tasks.title: Implement SHA registration outside worktree
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/store.js exports registerCommitSHA; persists SHA in executor state after commit confirmation; does not embed SHA in commit itself (no recursive commits)
tasks.groupingRationale: SHA registration is a single state update that occurs after commit confirmation; separating the commit from SHA recording prevents recursive commits while maintaining atomicity of the registration step

commit.subject: add SHA registration outside worktree

tasks.title: Implement commit/ledger reconciliation and task completion
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js finalizes ledger entry only after SHA registered and verified on feature branch; marks task checkpointed; closes task activity in ledger
tasks.groupingRationale: Commit/ledger reconciliation is the final task completion step; SHA verification, ledger finalization, and task marking must occur atomically to enforce BR-10 (completion requires all three)

commit.subject: add commit/ledger reconciliation and task completion

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to resume from persisted evidence and reconcile without re-execution, so that I can recover from interruptions safely

commit.subject: implement US-06 resume and replan

tasks.title: Implement resume and reconcile command logic
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js exports resume and reconcile commands; loads persisted state and evidence; classifies task status per edge-cases table; returns next safe action
tasks.groupingRationale: Resume and reconcile command logic is a single decision point that loads state, classifies task status, and returns the next safe action; all three steps are interdependent and must be atomic

commit.subject: add resume and reconcile command logic

tasks.title: Implement evidence evaluation per edge-cases table
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js evaluates persisted evidence (checkpoint, commit, review, diff, worker liveness) and determines: no-reimplementation, reconcile-SHA, recheck-verification, preserve-diff, or block
tasks.groupingRationale: Evidence evaluation implements the deterministic edge-cases table; all evidence signals (checkpoint, commit, review, diff, liveness) must be evaluated together to classify task status and detect corrupted/modified state (AC-12)

commit.subject: add evidence evaluation per edge-cases table

tasks.title: Implement replan command with approval validation
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js exports replan command; validates successor plan Gate 2 approval; records old->new plan digest mapping; preserves original run and attempts; does not auto-start successor
tasks.groupingRationale: Replan command is a single orchestration step that validates approval, maps plan digests, and preserves history; all steps are prerequisites for a valid replan transition and cannot be meaningfully split

commit.subject: add replan command with approval validation

tasks.title: Write resume and replan integration tests
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/resume-replan.test.js covers resume dedup (no re-dispatch while worker live), evidence classification, replan approval flow, repeated resume idempotency
tasks.groupingRationale: Integration test for resume and replan requires testing dedup, evidence classification, approval flow, and idempotency together; these behaviors are interdependent and require a single comprehensive test suite

commit.subject: add resume and replan integration tests

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to run sequential execution with one active task, so that I can execute safely in a single worktree

commit.subject: implement US-07 sequential execution

tasks.title: Implement sequential executor main loop with ready-queue dispatch
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js execute with maxConcurrency=1 reserves one task slot; dispatches from ready queue; reserves slot through dispatch/verify/review/checkpoint/commit; releases after integration or safe stop
tasks.groupingRationale: Sequential executor main loop enforces the one-active-task invariant (AC-06) through a single slot-reservation mechanism; the loop, dispatcher, and slot lifecycle must be implemented atomically to prevent interleaving

commit.subject: add sequential executor main loop

tasks.title: Implement cooperative and immediate stop modes
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js stop command with mode graceful (complete running verification, block new dispatch) or immediate (request termination, await confirmed stop); persists stop request; status confirms stop
tasks.groupingRationale: Stop modes (graceful and immediate) are dual-path implementations of a single coordinated shutdown mechanism; both require stop-request persistence and status confirmation, making them an atomic implementation unit

commit.subject: add cooperative and immediate stop modes

tasks.title: Write sequential execution end-to-end tests
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/sequential.test.js covers task ordering, one-at-a-time capacity invariant, stop modes, partial results before stop, recovery on resume
tasks.groupingRationale: End-to-end tests for sequential execution must verify task ordering, capacity invariant, stop modes, and recovery together; these behaviors are interdependent and require a single test suite

commit.subject: add sequential execution E2E tests

phases.title: As a coordinator, I want to run parallel execution with N isolated worktrees, so that I can execute independent tasks concurrently

commit.subject: implement US-08 parallel execution with isolated worktrees

tasks.title: Implement isolated worktree creation and management
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js creates worktree under run-owned root; unique path per attempt/task; returns worktree path and cleanup callback; validates worktree independence
tasks.groupingRationale: Isolated worktree creation and management is a single lifecycle module; path uniqueness, independence validation, and cleanup callback must all be coordinated atomically to prevent worktree collisions

commit.subject: add isolated worktree creation and management

tasks.title: Implement N-limit concurrency control and slot reservation
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js with maxConcurrency=N reserves N task slots; increments active slot counter at dispatch; decrements only after integration verified; enforces N limit
tasks.groupingRationale: N-limit concurrency control is a single slot-management mechanism; the increment/decrement lifecycle and enforcement of the N limit must be implemented atomically to prevent over-subscription

commit.subject: add N-limit concurrency control

tasks.title: Implement serial integration with dispatch-order sequencing
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/git.js exports integrateAttempt; cherry-picks from attempt branch to integration worktree; advances feature ref via compare-and-swap at expected HEAD; integrations serial by dispatch sequence
tasks.groupingRationale: Serial integration with dispatch-order sequencing is a single atomic operation; cherry-pick, ref advancement via compare-and-swap, and sequence enforcement must be coordinated together to prevent integration conflicts

commit.subject: add serial integration with dispatch-order sequencing

tasks.title: Implement original and integrated SHA tracking
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/store.js tracks originalSha (from attempt technical branch) and integratedSha (on feature branch after cherry-pick) separately; updates integration attempt record
tasks.groupingRationale: Original and integrated SHA tracking is a single state-update operation; both SHAs must be recorded together in the integration record to preserve the complete audit trail of the cherry-pick

commit.subject: add original and integrated SHA tracking

tasks.title: Configure and verify npm distribution payload
tasks.outcome: package.json "files" includes lib/task-executor/ and the bin CLI entry; tests/task-executor/ and fixtures are excluded; npm pack --dry-run confirms the executor module and CLI are present in the tarball and that test/fixture paths are absent
tasks.groupingRationale: Distribution payload composition — including the executor module and bin CLI in the npm package and excluding tests/fixtures, verified by npm pack — is a single packaging concern owned by US-08 (AC-14). It is kept separate from US-09 asset-catalog registration to remove the prior duplication and avoid a US-08→US-09 dependency inversion; it depends only on the module skeleton (INFRA-TASK-BE-03).

commit.subject: configure and verify npm distribution payload

tasks.title: Implement platform qualification guard (refuse non-Windows execution)
tasks.outcome: lib/task-executor/index.js execute() aborts with a non-zero platform-unsupported error when process.platform is not win32 — before any agent dispatch or worktree creation — enforcing the E-02 process-supervision qualification which is proven for Windows only
tasks.groupingRationale: The platform qualification guard is a single fail-closed precondition enforcing the E-02 Windows-only qualification. It must abort execute() before dispatch or worktree creation on unqualified platforms and is implemented as one cohesive check.

commit.subject: add platform qualification guard (Windows-only)

tasks.title: Write parallel execution end-to-end tests
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/parallel.test.js covers N slot reservation, concurrent dispatch, serial integration, dedup prevention, integration conflict handling, N=2/3 scenarios
tasks.groupingRationale: Comprehensive parallel scenarios (N slot control, concurrent dispatch, serial integration, dedup, conflicts) with N=2/3 variations require integration testing at this granularity; the scenarios are interdependent and require a single test suite to verify concurrent behaviour.

commit.subject: add parallel execution E2E tests

tasks.title: Test platform qualification guard prevents non-Windows execution
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/platform-guard.test.js asserts that with process.platform simulated as non-win32, execute() aborts with the platform-unsupported error and dispatches no agent and creates no worktree; and asserts win32 passes the guard
tasks.groupingRationale: This is a behavioural test that the platform guard actually prevents execution on unqualified platforms — not merely a documentation grep. It asserts abort, no dispatch, and no worktree on non-win32 and pass on win32 as one cohesive guard-behaviour suite.

commit.subject: add platform qualification guard tests

phases.title: As a project manager, I want to integrate the executor into implement-feature and test it with real features, so that the toolkit is production-ready

commit.subject: implement US-09 executor integration and end-to-end testing

tasks.title: Integrate new executor into implement-feature skill
tasks.outcome: src/claude/skills/implement-feature/SKILL.md dispatches executor start command after Gate 2; removes old pm-phase3 grouping path; presents run command to user
tasks.groupingRationale: Integration of the executor into implement-feature is a single skill modification; dispatcher routing, old-path removal, and user-facing command presentation form a cohesive feature-delivery integration point

commit.subject: integrate executor into implement-feature skill

tasks.title: Add executor CLI commands to bin/cli.js
tasks.outcome: bin/cli.js exports executor command dispatcher; routes start/status/diagnose/stop/reconcile/resume/replan to lib/task-executor/index.js; implements CLI contract with exit codes and JSON output
tasks.groupingRationale: Executor CLI dispatcher is a single command-routing layer; all seven commands (start/status/diagnose/stop/reconcile/resume/replan) route through a unified exit-code and JSON-output contract that must be implemented atomically

commit.subject: add executor CLI commands to bin/cli.js

tasks.title: Register executor module and CLI in asset catalog
tasks.outcome: lib/asset-catalog.js registers the task-executor module and its CLI commands so the toolkit resolver and preflight recognise them
tasks.groupingRationale: Asset-catalog registration of the executor module and CLI is a single resolver-facing concern. Distribution payload configuration (package.json files / npm pack) is owned separately by US-08-TASK-INFRA-01 to avoid duplication.

commit.subject: register executor module and CLI in asset catalog

tasks.title: Write fault injection and recovery tests
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/fault-injection.test.js covers crash windows: before/after dispatch, verification, checkpoint-prepared, commit, state-write, ledger-finalization; verifies no false completions and artifact preservation
tasks.groupingRationale: Fault injection and recovery tests cover the mandatory negative test (AC-10) — no task completion on model self-report alone — plus 10+ checkpoint boundaries with different failure modes; this requires comprehensive coverage at a single test granularity to verify artifact preservation and prevent false completions

commit.subject: add fault injection and recovery tests

tasks.title: Document executor CLI contract
tasks.outcome: docs/task-executor-cli.md documents the seven commands, their flags, exit codes, and the JSON result schema

It is separated from the bootstrap/runtime-constraints guide so each document has its own result, verification, estimate, and commit.

commit.subject: add executor CLI reference documentation

tasks.title: Document bootstrap procedure and runtime constraints
tasks.outcome: docs/task-executor-bootstrap.md documents the supervised task-by-task delivery procedure after Gates 1/2 and declares the Windows-only E-02 qualification and the persistence caveats
tasks.groupingRationale: The bootstrap and runtime-constraints guide is a single knowledge artifact declaring the supervised delivery procedure and the Windows-only E-02 qualification with persistence caveats. It is separated from the CLI reference so each document has its own result, verification, estimate, and commit.

commit.subject: add executor bootstrap and runtime-constraints guide

tasks.title: Execute authorized end-to-end test with real feature and Claude runtime
tasks.outcome: tests/task-executor/real-feature.test.js runs executor against approved real feature with actual Claude implementation agents; documents observed token usage, cancellation behavior, runtime bridge constraints; stores evidence under evidence/FTR-018-e2e/
tasks.groupingRationale: Real-feature end-to-end execution with authorized paid model invocation and full runtime observation (AC-15) cannot be compressed; estimate excludes token cost (depends on feature size and model invocations); this is the mandatory qualification proof that mocks cannot provide
